request.query: Finset.inf less than a value iff exists member with value less than cutoff

items.name: Finset.inf'_lt_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf' H f < a ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i < a

items.name: Finset.inf_lt_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderTop α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf f < a ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b < a

items.name: Finset.inf_le_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderTop α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  a < ⊤ → (s.inf f ≤ a ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b ≤ a)

items.name: Finset.inf'_le_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf' H f ≤ a ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≤ a

items.name: biInf_lt_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : CompleteLinearOrder α] {a : α} {s : Set β} {f : β → α},
  ⨅ i ∈ s, f i < a ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i < a

items.name: ciInf_lt_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_4} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] {a : α} [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → α},
  BddBelow (Set.range f) → (iInf f < a ↔ ∃ i, f i < a)

items.name: Set.Finite.lt_csInf_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] {s : Set α} {a : α},
  s.Finite → s.Nonempty → (a < sInf s ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, a < x)

items.name: Finset.lt_inf_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderTop α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  a < ⊤ → (a < s.inf f ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, a < f b)
